sprint: BACKLOG.md bug fix -- 'Frame style comes over the art.' A full-cover Frame Style = Image ornament used to overpaint the interior artwork region as well as the frame band, because both engines clipped the ornament to the whole outer frame path rather than the frame band alone. Both engines now clip the ornament image to the frame BAND only via an evenodd (outer-XOR-inner) clip, mirroring _ornamentWooden's already-correct band-only technique. Root Studio's _ornamentImage extracts a new shared _bandOnlyClip(rect,border) helper reusing _getDesignInsets + _frameFillPath + inner _picturePath/rect with x.clip('evenodd'); World Builder v2's _paintFrameOrnament image branch mirrors the same technique by hand using insets.marginPx (outer boundary) and insets.contentInset (inner boundary). Any ornament calling this then drawing with fill()/drawImage() is now structurally restricted to the frame band alone.
